import hashlib, importlib.metadata as metadata, json, pathlib, sys, sysconfig
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import apatch, apatch_studio
from apatch_studio.app import create_app
from apatch_studio.cli import _parser
site = pathlib.Path(sysconfig.get_path("purelib")).resolve()
for module in (apatch, apatch_studio):
    assert pathlib.Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(site)
assert apatch.__version__ == metadata.version("apatch") == "0.8.49"
assert apatch_studio.__version__ == metadata.version("apatch-studio") == "0.1.3"
web = site / "apatch_studio/_web"
assets = {"/" + path.relative_to(web).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in web.rglob("*") if path.is_file() and path.name != "index.html"}
app = create_app(sys.argv[1])
with TestClient(app, base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8765") as client:
    health = client.get("/api/v1/health")
    root = client.get("/")
    assert health.status_code == 200 and health.json()["version"] == "0.1.3"
    assert root.status_code == 200 and "__APATCH_STUDIO_SESSION__" not in root.text
    assert next(route.path for route in app.routes if route.path == "/assets") == "/assets"
    served = {}
    for url, expected in assets.items():
        response = client.get(url)
        assert response.status_code == 200
        actual = hashlib.sha256(response.content).hexdigest()
        assert actual == expected, url
        served[url] = actual
commands = set(_parser()._subparsers._group_actions[0].choices)
assert commands == {"serve", "name-this-machine", "enroll"}
print(json.dumps({"studio_version": "0.1.3", "sdk_version": "0.8.49", "wheel_imports": {"apatch": apatch.__file__, "apatch_studio": apatch_studio.__file__}, "commands": sorted(commands), "served_assets": served, "health_http": 200, "root_http": 200}))
